question: Arc 7 was also packed with an overwhelming amount of information and a nonstop series of developments. Was the overall length of Arc 7 what you expected? If it grew larger than expected, what caused that?
answer:
It wasn't what I expected!

The reason was that Arc 7 completely replaced the cast of characters we'd had up until then.

But by going to the Empire and introducing so many characters, I got to see new sides of Otsuka-sensei's range of ideas, which is thanks to me... (laughs)

(I've had him design around 30 new characters in about two years.)

Anyway, Otsuka-sensei is incredible!!

I give him the settings for each character, but he doesn't send them one at a time. He'll send all nine Divine Generals together in one batch!

He'll say things like, “It's easier for me when there's a group because the personalities come out more naturally,” but drawing nine characters isn't exactly easy, and yet he casually goes ahead and does things like that.

And there's something else: sometimes Otsuka-sensei will scribble a little drawing in the corner of a page, and I'll end up using it as-is. For example, the Shudraq were originally all just characters Otsuka-sensei had sketched off to the side. But they already had enough personality that I thought, “It'd be a waste not to use these...” and that's how every member of the Shudraq ended up getting a name.

Incidentally, there are also the Madelyn who replaced Balleroy, and Kafma, who insists that he's “at the level of a Divine General,” so technically there are eleven Divine Generals...
